nativePaths.finding: Stopped cache operations become a TypeError. The logging helper independently emits a JavaScript/error console message with a Cache API operation failed prefix; handling the returned exception does not remove that native console event.
An asynchronous cache query/put/delete settlement can take the stopped-context logging branch. QueryCache underlies Cache.match. This is reachable independently of Response.clone.
CacheStorage enumeration/open also has stopped-context rejection/logging paths. Some stopped paths do not log, so a rejected operation is not sufficient to infer the console event.

Two separate exact-string InvalidStateError paths remain: static Response.json construction without a global object, and Response.clone on a loading response whose context global is unavailable. These are not instance response.json consumption.
